name: nsg-video
description: Neo Space Group promo video built with Remotion (Arabic + English)

scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:60 && npm run render:b && npm run render:b60
scripts.music: node scripts/make-music.mjs 30 /tmp/m30.wav && ffmpeg -y -i /tmp/m30.wav -af "aecho=0.8:0.5:250|500:0.18|0.1,loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=9" -ar 48000 -b:a 192k public/music-b-30.mp3 && node scripts/make-music.mjs 60 /tmp/m60.wav && ffmpeg -y -i /tmp/m60.wav -af "aecho=0.8:0.5:250|500:0.18|0.1,loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=9" -ar 48000 -b:a 192k public/music-b-60.mp3
scripts.render:clips: for c in pixel zoom orbit layers memory night art map riyadh pixels cloud coast road; do remotion render Clip-$c out/clip-$c.mp4; done
scripts.render:vertical: for c in pixel zoom orbit layers memory night art map riyadh pixels cloud coast road; do remotion render Vertical-$c out/vertical/vertical-$c.mp4 --crf=23; done
